# Memento

> Claude Code plugin for persistent, file-based task memory: the agent keeps every task in five Markdown files with strict roles, keeps them current on its own, and lets outside models from other families check the memory cold. Long-term memory for AI agents with no database and no MCP server.

Key facts:

- One folder per task, five files: CLAUDE.md (charter, auto-loaded by Claude Code), MEMORY.md (dated facts with sources), TASKS.md (plan), DECISIONS.md (append-only decision records; a revision is a D1.1 block, the original stays), BRIEF.md (the original problem statement and definition of done). A workspace INDEX.md registers every task folder.
- The agent creates the folder itself when a task crosses the threshold (more than a day, 2+ stakeholders, a release artifact, 2+ phases) and syncs memory in a fixed order with a self-check against the schema.
- Insights are falsifiable hypotheses with `falsifier` and `depends_on`; refuted ones are kept and checked before every new decision (dead-end recall).
- Outside observers: other model families (their own APIs or OpenRouter, keys from environment variables) read the memory cold as verifier, Sapper, pattern scout and auditor; high-stakes claims get a panel vote.
- Guards: Stop hooks (Node.js) refuse to end a turn while memory is behind; every turn that changed memory is snapshotted into a 20-deep backup ring; `/memento-md:check` verifies a cold start, including a moved workspace.
- Commands: `/memento-md:init <workspace>`, `/memento-md:check`, `/memento-md:observers <question>`. Install: `/plugin marketplace add AndreySukhanov/memento`, then `/plugin install memento-md@memento`.
- Optional mod `memento-panel` (Claude Code 2.1.287+, `/plugin install memento-panel@memento`): a band above the prompt when memory falls behind and a pane with active tasks, next steps, checkpoints and unverified insights; read-only.
- `mode: core` in INDEX.md keeps only the seven core rules; the other layers run when asked for by name.
- Version 3.0.0; plugin name `memento-md`; Source-Available license - free to read, run and learn from for non-commercial use.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/README.md): the problem, how it works, features, quick start, FAQ
- [Task memory skill](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/skills/task-memory/SKILL.md): the method the agent follows - threshold, file roles, sync order, insights, observers, guards
- [Schema](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/docs/SCHEMA.md): every required shape - insight frontmatter, decision blocks, correction lenses, checkpoint YAML, index rows
- [Rationale](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/docs/RATIONALE.md): why each rule exists and the failure it came from
- [Worked example](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/examples/checkout-latency-bug): a task folder six weeks in

## Optional

- [Retrieval contract](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/memento/blob/master/docs/RETRIEVAL.md): how external search runtimes index the Markdown memory
